cards.card_name: Faysal Islami Priority World Debit Card

requirements.annual_fee_waiver_rule: Complimentary while Priority World eligibility is maintained (NTB: PKR 5Mn CASA / PKR 15Mn Term Deposit at account opening; ETB: PKR 5Mn quarterly average CASA / PKR 15Mn TD; or Employee Banking PKR 1,000,000 gross salary per month). Otherwise quarterly fee of Rs. 5,000 (primary) / Rs. 3,000 (supplementary) applies.

notes: Re-verified 2026-09-23 against the Jul-Dec 2026 SOC (SOC-Eng-Jul-Dec-2026.pdf, valid 1 July-31 December 2026) Faysal Islamic Priority Banking section 4: quarterly non-maintenance fee Rs. 5,000 primary (was Rs. 4,250) / Rs. 3,000 supplementary (was Rs. 2,500); new Employee Banking route of PKR 1,000,000 gross salary per month for the World card, so minimum_monthly_salary_pkr changed 500,000 -> 1,000,000. CASA/TD thresholds unchanged.
SOC Jan-Jun 2026 Section 4 (Faysal Islamic Priority Banking) explicitly lists Priority World Debit threshold: NTB CASA PKR 5Mn / TD PKR 15Mn; ETB CASA PKR 5Mn avg quarterly / TD PKR 15Mn.
General Priority Banking status (not the World card waiver) still has a PKR 500,000 gross salary Employee Banking route per the same SOC section and /priority/priority-experience/.
Priority status also reachable via AUM PKR 10Mn + PKR 1.5Mn avg quarterly CASA (recorded as relationship balance).
